Oracle Fusion 26B: former opt-ins now standard

Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list names 11 features whose opt-in period ended with 26B. They are now standard: 6 are switched on automatically, and 5 need setup if you want to use them. By area: all 11 across Financials, Projects and Supply Chain.

HCM changes are not on this list: Oracle announces them as Redwood default switches. See HCM pages switching to Redwood.

Oracle's note: if you already opted in and finished the setup, nothing changes for you. "Now enabled" and "Oracle's impact" are Oracle's own columns.
